newsitem.title: UK: UK machine tool turnover up in 3mths to July.
newsitem.headline: UK machine tool turnover up in 3mths to July.

text.p: Turnover of UK machine tools rose by a seasonally adjusted 0.4 percent in the three months to July compared with the previous three, the Office for National Statistics said.
This was due to a 2.2 percent increase in export turnover, more than offsetting a 0.6 percent fall in home turnover.
Compared to the same period a year ago, total turnover increased by 1.3 percent.
Total orders on hand for machine tools at the end of July, showed a 0.2 percent fall compared with the level at the end of April and was 13.5 percent down on July 1995.
